$comment: AutoStacc engine contract v1: the words an engine suggests values from, sent with a job (server/discovery/vocabulary.js engineVocabulary(); a copy for the conformance suite is engine/conformance/vocabulary.json). kinds: each kind with the formats filed under it (audio formats are those of one-shots). words: folded word or phrase (lower case, words joined by '-') to value, per field. keys: the key values ('a-minor', 'cs-major'). bpm: the accepted tempo range. An engine compiles none of this in.
